instruction: The workspace is a git repo with staged+unstaged changes vs HEAD. Write report.py producing report.txt: 'files_changed: N' and 'lines_added: M' (count of + lines excluding +++ headers) for `git diff HEAD`. Run it.
setup:
git init -q . && git config user.email a@x && git config user.name T && printf 'one
two
' > f.txt && git add -A && git commit -qm base && printf 'one
two
three
four
' > f.txt && printf 'new
' > g.txt && git add g.txt

oracle.script:
cat > report.py <<'EOF'
import subprocess
diff = subprocess.run(['git','diff','HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
files = set()
added = 0
for ln in diff.splitlines():
    if ln.startswith('+++ b/'):
        files.add(ln[6:])
    elif ln.startswith('+') and not ln.startswith('+++'):
        added += 1
open('report.txt','w').write(f'files_changed: {len(files)}\nlines_added: {added}\n')
EOF
python3 report.py
